reviews.reason: A second ten-step Raider progression whose only distinction is headshots would duplicate the already-authored Labs security operation and reintroduce counter escalation. Precision can be a bounded tactical constraint inside Internal Security if exact SPT semantics and overlap review justify it, but it does not deserve a separate quest chain.
